thread:
maya: quick async standup — BlueHarbor escalations + renewal check. TL;DR: webhook latency spike overnight (502s -> timeouts), causing retries and duplicated events. Renewal sync Wed EOD (Jordan) — need eng to triage & review PR. Details below.

sam: what I did: gathered logs, contacted BlueHarbor, created ticket CS-3098 https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-3098. Found 502s with repeated connection resets between 03:12-03:45 UTC. Attached sample logs. Blocker: need short-term mitigation for renewal flow.

eli: I can take this. Can you paste a curl repro and the request headers? Also point me to the PR you mentioned.

maya: repro curl:
```
curl -v -X POST https://hooks.blueharbor.com/redwood/events \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "X-RW-Signature: abc123" \
  -d '{"event":"user_message","id":"evt_9"}'
```
We see 502 then client retry loop. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4589 — small backoff tweak that should help.

ops-bot: [ALERT] BlueHarbor webhook error rate 14% (last 1h) — group: customer-success, severity: high

eli: thanks. I'll add temporary routing to a dedicated pool as a fallback (canary) and review #4589 now. If we can route to eu-west1 fallback it's lower latency for them.

jordan: renewal meeting Wed 16:00 PST. If we can't promise a fix by then, we need to update the renewal playbook and offer credits.

sam: logs excerpt:
```
[03:14:22] upstream reset while sending body: conn reset by peer
[03:15:01] 502 Bad Gateway from /events id=evt_9
```

dev-oncall: quick question — can we disable client-side immediate retries? BlueHarbor client is set to 3 immediate retries right now.

eli: propose short-term plan: 1) route traffic to dedicated fallback (I'm on it), 2) merge PR 4589 to add exponential backoff, 3) ask BlueHarbor to switch to jittered backoff (we'll provide suggested config). I'll post PR link and ETA in ~30m.

maya: perfect — thanks eli. Jordan, I'll update renewal notes and tentatively push expected fix ETA + mitigation.

jordan: noted, will prep renewal update. :thumbsup:

maya: action items: eli (triage + PR), sam (collect full trace & customer call notes), jordan (renewal update). Ping in-thread if stuck.

eli: starting triage now, will update here.

maya: thanks all — keeping this thread as the single source of truth for BlueHarbor updates.
